description: A PLL whose feedback goes through a BUFG gets its output clocks derived
exercises: a PLLE2_ADV with CLKFBOUT -> BUFG -> CLKFBIN, as the clocking wizard builds it
the derived VCO and output constraints of generate_constraints()
the output domain timed at its own frequency, not at the 12 MHz default
why: generate_constraints() derived a PLL's VCO and output clocks only when CLKFBIN was driven by the PLL itself. Vivado's clocking wizard puts a BUFG in the loop, so release 2026-10-16 skips such a PLL: the log stops at the input frequency, the output domain is timed at the 12 MHz default, and the design builds all the same. openXC7/nextpnr 39a39917 follows the clock buffers back to the PLL's own port.
